basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old based in Las Vegas, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrency and spend my free time exploring new investment opportunities. I dislike loud environments and large gatherings, preferring quiet and solitude. I am usually online during late evenings after work and on weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom it brings, I often find myself deep into Reddit discussions and learning about new technologies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in graphic design, I have honed my skills through self-teaching and online courses. My interest in cryptocurrency began a year ago, and I've been actively learning through online communities and resources.
